title: Regression tests protect fixes
summary: A regression happens when something that worked stops working. Add a test for a fixed bug so later changes check it again.
introduction: A regression happens when something that worked stops working. Add a test for a fixed bug so later changes check it again. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A regression happens when something that worked stops working. Add a test for a fixed bug so later changes check it again.

blocks.code:
Bug: empty basket crashed
Fix: use zero as the starting total
Regression test: empty basket total equals zero
blocks.title: Regression tests protect fixes

blocks.text: The test records the behaviour that should stay fixed.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Describe a regression test for a repaired Next button.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not remove the test as soon as the bug is fixed.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
